title: One app, all in the browser
caption: Published on GitHub Pages from CI and everything runs in the browser; the server at the bottom is planned, described in the repo.

shop.label: Store
shop.note: The buyer's store: catalogue, stack builder, tiered club, a game that gives coupons, and gifts.

admin.label: Panel
admin.note: The owner's panel, with direct demo access on purpose and the «Demo» sign in view: it is presented as a demo.

features.label: Containers
features.note: Pages hand off here: each container joins the stores' state with the pure rules engine.

engine.label: Pure engine
engine.note: Pricing, coupons, stock, order states and the game are pure, tested functions, outside the components.

stores.label: Stores
stores.note: They rehydrate after the first render to keep the static HTML intact, with versioned migrations of what was saved.

fixtures.label: Catalogue
fixtures.note: The demo's fictional data: an invented brand, products and orders, read by the engine.

ls.label: localStorage
ls.note: What is saved, as JSON with each brand's own prefix: two demos on the same domain stay apart.

prod.label: Server
prod.note: Planned: in production the engine moves into server services and the components are reused. It is described in the repo.
